feature_packed_softmax_override.scope: M4/M5 1024-slot multi-head path only; the M3 generic Softmax contract is unchanged
feature_packed_softmax_override.inactive_slot_cleanup: subtract the frozen P_exp(0) plaintext only from public inactive slots

feature_packed_layernorm_override.scope: M4/M5 FeaturePacked LayerNorm only; generic M3 LayerNorm is unchanged
feature_packed_layernorm_override.fixed_shape: 2 sites x 12 layers x 5 public token rows; 768 active features in 1024 slots
feature_packed_layernorm_override.scale_selection: pre-registered D=2^roundTiesToEven(log2(64/raw_population_variance)) selected only by public site/layer/token coordinates
feature_packed_layernorm_override.active_epsilon_placement: public epsilon is multiplied by the selected D and added to the active 768-slot prefix before native bootstrap
feature_packed_layernorm_override.pre_bootstrap_values: active u/2048 and inactive public guard 1/2048
feature_packed_layernorm_override.post_bootstrap_restore: one uniform all-1024-slot public multiplication by 2048 on each ciphertext
feature_packed_layernorm_override.post_inverse_cleanup: one public first-768-active/last-256-zero Ct-Pt mask and explicit rescale before the centered Ct-Ct merge
feature_packed_layernorm_override.gamma_application: per-token public gamma*sqrt(D) Ct-Pt multiplication on the centered branch before the inverse-sqrt merge
